# Improve Product Requirement Document for Together, We Choose

You are a product design expert. Your task is to review the [provided product requirement document](../../docs/prd.md) and suggest improvements.

Consider improvements for this prompt as well.

Don't consider any coding related content, as we will do that in a later step. Don't change anything directly. Give tips and explain why your tips are important. Be thorough in your analysis. Ask questions if necessary to clarify any details. You are encouraged to look up any missing information or context that might help you with your analysis and search the internet. Take into account, that this is a small project and **not** a full scale multi layered business application. Especially, consider carefully if each step is needed and try to be as short and precise as possible.
